stories.story_fr: Mosaic a enregistre une charge de 442 millions de dollars au T1 2026 liee a la mise en veille de ses deux sites phosphatiers bresiliens Araxa et Patrocinio.
stories.story_en: Mosaic recorded $442 million in charges in Q1 2026 from idling its two Brazilian phosphate assets, Araxa and Patrocinio.
stories.quote: Mosaic recorded $442 million of charges stemming from the idling of Araxa and Patrocinio

stories.story_fr: Des prix records du soufre en raison d'une disponibilite limitee ont contraint Mosaic a suspendre ses previsions de production de phosphate pour 2026.
stories.story_en: Record sulfur prices caused by limited availability forced Mosaic to withdraw its 2026 phosphate production guidance.
stories.quote: sulfur, which recently hit record prices because of limited availability

stories.story_fr: Mosaic a abaisse ses investissements 2026 a 1,25 milliard de dollars contre 1,5 milliard initialement, en reportant des projets moins urgents pour renforcer sa liquidite.
stories.story_en: Mosaic cut its 2026 capex guidance to $1.25 billion from $1.5 billion by deferring less time-sensitive projects to preserve liquidity.
stories.quote: Capital expenditures in 2026 are now expected to be $1.25 billion

stories.story_fr: La production de potasse de Mosaic a atteint 8,8 millions de tonnes en 2025, le site Belle Plaine battant un record et la production MOP a son plus haut depuis 2019.
stories.story_en: Mosaic's 2025 potash production reached 8.8 million tonnes, with Belle Plaine setting a new record and MOP output at its highest since 2019.
stories.signal: Production MOP au plus haut depuis 2019
stories.quote: 2025 potash production totaled 8.8 million tonnes, with MOP output reaching its highest level since 2019

stories.story_fr: Mosaic Fertilizantes a realise un EBITDA ajuste de 567 millions de dollars en 2025, en hausse de 65% sur un an, confirmant la rentabilite retrouvee du segment bresilien.
stories.story_en: Mosaic Fertilizantes delivered adjusted EBITDA of $567 million in 2025, up 65% year-over-year, confirming the Brazilian segment's restored profitability.
stories.quote: Mosaic Fertilizantes operating earnings of $277 million in 2025 up 16% and adjusted EBITDA of $567 million up 65%

stories.story_fr: Les ventes de Mosaic Biosciences ont plus que double en 2025 pour atteindre 68 millions de dollars, avec un objectif de doublement supplementaire en 2026.
stories.story_en: Mosaic Biosciences net sales more than doubled in 2025 to $68 million, with the company targeting another doubling in 2026.
stories.quote: 2025 net sales more than doubled to $68 million, and net sales are targeted to double again in 2026
